investigator_reason: Original 10-K for 2024. Management states the Company acquired Svenska Petroleum Exploration AB during 2024 and excluded it from the ICFR assessment as of Dec 31, 2024. Event, exercise and name are all present.

The 2024 items are a non-license asset purchase (KAZT-TV) and a larger stake in the already-controlled CW, not a newly acquired business (fails the event test). No exclusion, so management's full assessment stands. No explanation for not using relief is required.

Controlling interest in Midwest Orthopedic Specialty Hospital, LLC acquired effective April 30, 2024; management excludes "this facility", whose antecedent is the named hospital in the adjacent sentence. Auditor corroborates. The reasons assessment was not possible are not given: a disclosure limit, not an eligibility failure.

Management excluded Platform Group Limited (Irwin) and Liquid Holdings, LLC (LiquidityBook), acquired in Q1 and Q2 of fiscal 2025. Both are named and both fall within one year. Period ended Aug 31, 2025.
G5 Infrared, LLC, acquired Feb 18, 2025, is excluded from the June 30, 2025 assessment. Named, dated and within one year.
The Fr8App merger closed in 2022, outside the acquisition year. No current exclusion; management's assessment is provided.
MTL Holdings LLC, acquired May 1, 2024, is excluded. The extract also gives its significance (about 8% of total assets), so the S1 significance requirement is met.
Evirth (Shanghai) Industrial Co., Ltd is excluded because it was acquired in a purchase business combination during the year. Named.

The proposed e2Companies merger terminated in July 2024, so no business was acquired (fails the event test). The later name change, new subsidiary and 2025 potential deal do not create one. No exclusion.
The acquisition note covers an older 2021 asset acquisition and dispositions. No current-year business acquisition and no exclusion.
Management's assertion excludes Book4Time, Inc. Named. Period ended March 31, 2025.
Nehring Electrical Works Company and Elkhart Products Corporation were acquired during 2024 and both are excluded.
A 10-K/A for FY2023 amending a report first filed 2024-03-28. The anchor is outside the window, the amendment is not a separate event, and no exclusion wording was found.
The evaluation did not include the internal controls of NTS, the entity acquired in the Acquisition. Named by short name; confirm the legal name in the acquisition note.
The acquired Benihana business is excluded "given the significance" of the acquisition, for the year ended Dec 31, 2024. Named.

Management excludes "the Atlanta Acquisition", "the Palm Acquisition", "the Macedonia Acquisition" and others (acquired Oct to Nov 2024). Event and exercise are clear, but these are defined labels, not business names. Camping World (#32) was excluded on the same ground. Read the defined terms: if each label is tied to a named entity or community, Eligible; if only to a location, Not eligible. RESOLVED 2026-11-02: Not eligible. The notes define the labels as asset acquisitions of unnamed senior living communities (2 in the Atlanta area; 8 "Palm Communities" bought from affiliates of Principal Senior Living Group; 1 in Macedonia, Ohio). The labels are tied to locations, not named businesses, consistent with #32.
The Asterias merger is historical. Management expressly includes consolidated subsidiaries in its assessment, so there is no exclusion.
Amerochem and Waterguard are excluded from management's assertion for the year ended March 30, 2025. Both named.

Management excludes "these acquired entities", which alone does not name them, but the report identifies Whitco Supply and Trojan Rentals (acquired during 2024) in the adjacent text. Auditor corroborates. Company-specific obstacles to assessment are not explained.
Management excluded "a portion of CSI Compressco", citing SEC staff guidance. The business is named but the exclusion is partial; confirm Item 9A describes the portion excluded.
The Mount Sinai arrangements are licences, not an acquired business (fails the event test). Material weaknesses do not create acquisition relief. No exclusion.
Coyote is excluded because it was acquired in a business combination during 2024. Named.
The assessment does not include Enercon, a majority-owned subsidiary acquired during 2024. Named.
ID R&D (2021) and HooYu (2022) fall outside the one-year limit. No current exclusion.
Standard Equipment Company, acquired Oct 4, 2024, is excluded. Named and dated.
The assessment as of Dec 31, 2024 did not include Carlisle or FCF, citing SEC guidance. Named by short form; confirm full names in the notes.
A 10-K/A for FY2023 (original filed 2024-03-14), so the anchor is outside the window. The exclusion text relates to a 2023 acquisition.
DocFox, Inc. (acquired Mar 20, 2024), Integrated Lending Technologies, LLC (Apr 1, 2024) and Artesian Solutions Limited are excluded. Period ended Jan 31, 2025.
Historical acquisitions and a 2021 IPO. No exclusion. An old IPO and continuing EGC status do not turn an omitted report into newly public relief.
Ghost Lifestyle LLC, acquired Dec 31, 2024, is excluded. Named; acquired on the last day of the year.

Management excludes the operations of businesses acquired in 2024 and expressly references Note 3, which names Sportech and RecPro; five of the seven acquisitions stay unnamed. Eligible at issuer level. Do not allocate aggregate percentages to individual businesses.

Exclusion is exercised and corroborated by the auditor, but the business is described ("tire rescue roadside assistance business", defined as the "2024 Excluded Acquisition"), not named. P1 requires a name. This is a study exclusion, not a finding that S1 identification was breached.
i3 Energy Plc was acquired during 2024 and is excluded. Named.
Spirent Communications plc, Synopsys' Optical Solutions Group and Ansys' PowerArtist RTL business are excluded. Period ended Oct 31, 2025, filed 2025-12-17; the tool places it in the window.
Sacred Wind was acquired in 2022, outside the one-year limit. No current exclusion and no missing disclosure identified.
Gravotech Holding, American Barcode and RFID Incorporated, and the Microfluidic Solutions business unit are excluded. Period ended July 31, 2025.
Megatran Industries, Inc. and its subsidiaries are excluded because they were acquired during the year. Period ended March 31, 2025.
Bailiwick is excluded from the evaluation for the year ended March 31, 2025. Named.
McGriff, acquired Nov 15, 2024, is excluded "as allowed by SEC guidance". Named and dated.
e-TeleQuote is excluded from the evaluation for the twelve months ended Dec 31, 2024. The extract gives no acquisition date, so confirm in the notes that it was a 2024 acquisition (S1 event test).
The operations of FCB are excluded, as permitted by Office of the Chief Accountant guidance. Named by abbreviation; confirm the full name in the merger note.
Snap One, acquired June 14, 2024, is excluded. Named and dated.

The personal care business of Curo Health Services, LLC (d/b/a Gentiva), the "Gentiva Acquisition", is excluded because it was acquired in a purchase business combination during the year. Named. This is the 30th eligible row.
